CustomField.label: SAML SSO Config Id
CustomField.description: Optional 15- or 18-character Salesforce Id of the SamlSsoConfig row. When set, discover uses this Id with Auth.AuthConfiguration.getSamlSsoUrl and skips querying SamlSsoConfig by DeveloperName — required for Experience Guest because Guest users typically cannot read SamlSsoConfig. Leave blank only if the runtime user can query SamlSsoConfig (unusual for community login).
